settings.autoApplyHint: A profile can apply its own speed while one of its programs is in the foreground. Off by default.
settings.gamepadHint: A gamepad combination does not go through the hotkey table, so it keeps working when the window loses focus or the game runs full screen. Record one by holding a gamepad button while recording a shortcut above.
settings.gamepadNone: No gamepad combination is bound yet.
settings.remoteControlHint: A small page on 127.0.0.1 that changes the speed without touching any game process. It needs the session token and is unreachable from other machines.

diag.title: Input diagnostics
diag.intro: Checks the chain from the OS hotkey table to the speed bridge. It never reads game memory, intercepts keys, or injects anything new.
diag.observeHint: Adds register_fail / hotkey_fired / inject_result records to the diagnostics log. Off by default.
diag.pollingHint: Reads the keyboard state instead of registering a hotkey. Use it when another program holds your combination.
diag.pollingNote: Polling only reads the keyboard. The game still receives the combination — nothing is intercepted.
diag.compatHint: Send every keyboard shortcut through the poller instead of the hotkey table.
diag.rustDispatchHint: The speed change is applied by the app core instead of the window, so it also works while the window is hidden.
diag.guardWarnOnlyHint: Rollback switch. Off refuses protected games; on downgrades the check to a strong warning. Off by default.
diag.retryHint: A combination another program holds is retried after 2 s, 4 s, 8 s, then every 10 s. Off by default.
diag.testNeedsObserve: Turn on input observation to run the check.
diag.testNoChord: No slot has a keyboard shortcut yet, so there is nothing to test.
diag.occupiedCode: code 1409 — the combination is already registered by another program
diag.gamepadHint: If the keyboard combination stays unusable, bind a gamepad combination in Settings — it does not depend on the window focus.
diag.logHint: Every check leaves [input] records in today's diagnostics log.

verdict.fired_no_inject: Fired, but the speed change went nowhere

verdictHint.not_registered: The OS refused the registration, so pressing the combination does nothing.
verdictHint.registered_no_fire: OpenSpeedy holds the combination but no callback arrived within 3 seconds. Press sooner after starting the check.
verdictHint.fired_no_inject: The hotkey reached OpenSpeedy, but no process is currently accepting a speed change. Enable speed on a game first, then check again.
verdictHint.ok: The combination is registered, the callback fired, and the bridge accepted a speed change.
